launch_encoder_server: launch a FastAPI multimodal encoder server with ZMQ and mooncake transfer backends
encode_multimodal_items: encode image video or audio items into embeddings with optional global cache lookup
send_embedding_to_prefill: send computed embeddings to prefill hosts via mooncake zero-copy or ZMQ transfer backend
run_encoder_profiler: start and stop torch profiler on encoder ranks to capture CPU and GPU performance traces
check_encoder_health: check encoder server health status via /health and /health_generate endpoints
